chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
Regarding a man who sells a slave and stipulates upon him that he should give him something, he said: "It is permissible."

key_terms.شَيْئًا: something unspecified as an additional item or benefit

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible for a seller to stipulate an additional condition when selling a slave?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on a sale involving a mamluk where the seller makes an additional stipulation for something to be given. The Imam عليه السلام rules that such a condition is permissible, indicating the validity of this kind of contractual term in the context mentioned.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: regarding a man who sells a slave and stipulates upon the buyer to give him something: "It is permissible."
